name: Osiajee Texfab Limited
about: Osiajee Texfab Limited, together with its subsidiary, trades in textile products in India. The company trades in fabrics through modern trade and e commerce platform. It also engages in the agro farming business. The company was formerly known as Osiajee Housing Developers Limited and changed its name to Osiajee Texfab Limited in May 2015. Osiajee Texfab Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hoshiarpur, India.
